text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you've defeated this many.
You're so amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなにいっぱい倒しちゃうなんて……
やっぱりお兄ちゃんはすごいです。

text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
Foggy still scares me,
but I'm fine if you're by my side.
Ehehe. Maybe I'll just stay beside you all day. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
……フォギーと戦うのはすごく怖いけど、
お兄ちゃんが隣に居れば平気です。
えへへ……
今日はずっとお兄ちゃんの隣にいようかな♪
